program.intent: Reversible transformation of timestamp into epoch microseconds
program.code:
def forward(groups):
    year, month, day, sp1, hour, minute, second, millis = groups
    timestamp = f"{year}-{month}-{day} {hour}:{minute}:{second}.{millis}"
    dt = datetime.strptime(timestamp, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S.%f')
    return {'stored': [int(dt.timestamp() * 1000000)], 'layout': [len(sp1)]}

def inverse(record):
    micros = int(record['stored'][0])
    layout = record.get('layout', [])
    sp1_len = int(layout[0])
    dt = datetime.fromtimestamp(micros / 1000000)
    return f"{dt.strftime('%Y-%m-%d')}" + (' ' * sp1_len) + dt.strftime('%H:%M:%S.%f')[:-3]
